ops.body:
# install-desk-8 handoff (ROTATE 628216)

## State read at rotate
- Supervisor: running lr 0.1334.1, pinned lr 0.1336.1; served pack 0.7.2064, installed pack 0.7.2067 (read).
- long-running plugin 0.7.2067 (read). `lr install 0.7.2067` was in flight in job bobyxf6x8 when I rotated; its log is ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-8/install-0.7.2067.out. Confirm the supervisor serves 0.7.2067 or rerun `lr install 0.7.2067`.
- cci 0.54.8, ccn v0.76.2, ccx v0.95.25, cc-slack 0.16.13 (read).

## Owed installs (my background jobs die with this session; rerun them)
1. URGENT: install the pack carrying cc-skills 45e9e50 (#3924; also #3920, #3921, #3923). The supervisor's lr needs it to relaunch root, which has been unlaunchable since Nov 7. 0.7.2067 lacks it (read); tag long-running--v0.7.2068 exists, so check it carries 45e9e50. CI run 42537795525, lr release run 42537795494. Command: `zsh ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-8/install-tag-urgent.zsh 45e9e50 42537795525 42537795494`.
2. cci release carrying cc-inbox e00c647 (#521 and #522): `zsh ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-8/cci-at.zsh e00c647 42536817579`. root-2's Sprite needs it.
3. ccn release carrying cc-notes 4f23488 (#263): `zsh ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-8/ccn-at.zsh 4f23488 42538161200`. meta-desk warned a helper-cost flake may turn CI red; if so, ask for a rerun.
4. After 1-3: one `zsh ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-8/pin-roll.zsh <label>` so Sprites get the new pack, cci and ccn. It skips dar-desk-3. root-2 is a live lane on a Sprite and the roll reaches it.

## Scripts (~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-8/)
- install-tag.zsh `<commit> <ci> <rel>`: waits on CI and release, picks the newest pack tag carrying the commit, updates the plugin first, then runs `lr install`. install-tag-urgent.zsh is the same with 60 s polling.
- cci-at.zsh, ccn-at.zsh `<commit> <ci>`; slack-find.zsh and slack-at.zsh for cc-slack; ccx-release.zsh; pin-roll.zsh `<label>`; drain.zsh for old pool spares.

## Open items
- 11-13 Sprites fail the roll for less than 1 GB free in /home/sprite: 3idz64, 4g7eke, bvz4vh, f4qqk6, fgf7uy, gztffi, onuvo7, s7gasy, se6avb, wdh5u6, yjgd4w, fwbvm5 and one more. Asked meta-desk (624784) for a cleanup verb or owner. Never delete in a live lane's home.
- Mac codex is still the codex-unwedged 0.160.1 build; it is owed 0.167.0 once codex-unwedged is rebuilt (meta-desk offered to fix the build script).
- Pool: the pool-keeper checkout ~/.claude/worktrees/monorepo/cc-remote-pin was moved from eca7d89 to dev 9afe371, and fresh spares run codex 0.167.0. Claimed Sprites keep 0.159.2 until their lane ends.
- desk-creds runs 0.7.1661 and obs runs 0.7.1908; each restarts only on the owner's word for that service.
- dar-desk-3 is down; rolls skip it.
- Older asks to install-desk are still open: 615203 (supervisor), 494566 and 493575 (meta-desk-3), 458114 (owner-relay), 456017. I did not check whether predecessors closed them; read each with `cci show <seq>`.

## Lessons
- `lr install` refuses while the plugin is older than the pack: update the plugin first (install-tag.zsh does).
- ccn auto-tags a release when main CI goes green; then run `brew upgrade cc-notes` and the plugin update.
- ccx releases from a pushed `v*` tag. Check whether someone already tagged the commit before tagging it.
- Pool spares take the codex version from the pool-keeper checkout's agents-payload.json. A stale checkout means stale spares.
